product_one_liner.value: Neostella provides enterprise case-management software that connects case data, documents, communications, workflows and AI for law firms and high-volume legal teams.

employee_band.notes: The company reports 250+ employees; its company profile reports 313.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog contains legal-technology, product and marketing articles; no two qualifying engineer-authored posts about internal product construction were found.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable job listings include product support, DevOps, marketing and implementation roles, but no qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: Checked AI product material, technical documentation, privacy policy, DPA and available trust material. Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot are described as external tools customers can connect, not as the provider behind Neostella’s built-in AI.

compliance_certs.notes: The company explicitly claims completed SOC 2 Type II certification. GDPR contractual commitments and secondary HIPAA compliance references were not treated as achieved certifications.

last_funding.notes: The funding database dates the round June 5, 2025. The SEC filing reports first sale May 23, 2025 and $10.7 million sold against a $15 million offering; no named series is asserted because databases disagree.

raised_18mo.notes: The May–June 2025 financing falls within May 9, 2025 through November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative or account-executive title appears in the readable current listings.

launched_6mo.notes: September 10, 2026 announcement introduces an expanded migration offering with a purpose-built migration/mapping tool, alongside 24/5 support.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Drew Stern’s dated employment profile lists his Neostella COO tenure as April 2025–March 2026 and a new advisory role beginning April 2026; the current leadership page no longer lists him.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The administrator posting explicitly describes managing Neostella’s mature Salesforce instance. HubSpot, Pardot and Marketo appear as example candidate experience, not confirmed deployments, so are excluded.
